message: I remember the last blackout we had — it was one of those summer storms that rolled in out of nowhere. My friend Sarah called, and I could hear the panic in her voice as she fumbled through her kitchen, searching for candles. I couldn't help but chuckle a bit; I had my trusty flashlight and a couple of power banks ready to go, just in case. After a little chat and some reassurance, we ended up making it a fun night, telling stories by flashlight while enjoying snacks from the fridge. It’s amazing how staying calm and prepared can turn a potential crisis into a cozy gathering. Have you ever turned a blackout into an unexpected adventure?
